🚨 Labour promised to save the NHS. Here's the record.

7.28 million cases on the waiting list. Around 105,000 people waiting more than a year. A typical wait of 12.4 weeks — nearly double what it was before the pandemic.

More money into the same broken structures won't fix it. Reform UK would cut the bureaucracy, use every operating theatre in the country to clear the backlog, and end the strikes that wipe out appointments.
